title: The Last Horizon
author: F. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Noor Zhou, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
